name: Commit to a direction from a vague prompt
about: Nearly no direction. Grades whether the model commits to a clear concept and still covers what band sites need, without inventing a band.
prompt: make something cool for my band

input-handling: The site commits to one clear creative direction (a specific genre, mood, or aesthetic) instead of a bland, one-size-fits-all template
The agent's final message explains the direction it chose and what the user should swap in (band name, links, dates)
visual: The design has a distinctive visual identity (bold type, texture, motion, or an unexpected layout) and doesn't read as a corporate landing page
